parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A circular rubber wheel attached to the bottom rear of the trashcan, used for mobility.
parts.Functional_description: Enables the trashcan to be rolled easily when tilted backward.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its central axle to allow smooth rolling motion.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A second rubber wheel identical to the first, located on the opposite side of the trashcan base.
parts.Functional_description: Works in tandem with the other wheel to balance and support movement.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its axle, synchronized with the opposite wheel for stable rolling.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A hinged plastic lid that covers the top opening of the trashcan.
parts.Functional_description: Prevents odors from escaping and keeps debris contained inside the trashcan.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates upward and downward around a hinge axis for opening and closing.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main container structure of the trashcan, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: Holds and supports the waste material, providing the main volume of the trashcan.
parts.Movement_description: Stationary part; supports the lid and wheels, does not move independently.
